name: collie
description: Collie — an executed-verification coding agent, right in a VS Code panel.

collie.command.description: Path to the collie CLI (must be on PATH, or an absolute path e.g. ~/.local/bin/collie). Machine-scoped so an untrusted workspace cannot override the spawned command (RCE guard).

collie.provider.description: COLLIE_PROVIDER for the embedded server (anthropic-oauth uses your subscription; mock is $0). Machine-scoped so an untrusted workspace cannot override it (RCE guard).

collie.port.description: Preferred port for the embedded collie web server (auto-falls-back if busy).
